seo.title: Lucas Machut, photographer and filmmaker in Rio de Janeiro
seo.description: Photography and film about people: weddings, festivals, sessions and travel. The bond, the movement, never the pose.

hero.eyebrow: Photographer and filmmaker · Rio de Janeiro

lines.t: no one was asked to pose for,

manifesto.text: I photograph the bond between people. What you feel when you are there, and what comes back years later, looking at the image again. Never the pose: the movement, the spontaneous, the details that slip away.

cards.title: Weddings and elopements
cards.text: The whole day without posing, from the first hug to the last song.

cards.title: Festivals and events
cards.text: Flash, a long lens and attention: the interactions no one sees.

cards.title: Sessions and portraits
cards.text: Couples, families, the body set free. In nature, in motion.

cards.title: Retreats and travel
cards.text: Experiences, adventure, a place with people in it.

title.t: Bodies in motion, feelings that are

film_noite.quote: In the end, it was never about how we look, but about who we are.
